decisions.reason: Only a website mention signals limited public commitment, so the product is somewhat easier to withdraw despite sunk costs, giving a moderate drop probability.
A dedicated product page and closeness to the established offer create strong public commitment and core centrality, making persistence highly likely.
A multi-model product line indicates large sunk investment and responsibility, and escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
Although fire protection flow monitoring is somewhat less central, its dedicated page and established technological base create visible commitment, so withdrawal is unlikely.
